manifesto.title: Innovation arrives without warning. Your software should adapt with you.
manifesto.lead: Your company has a unique way of working. We get to know it, talk to your team, and learn how you operate before writing a single line of code.
manifesto.marginalia: Culture is what sets a company apart. Your software should carry yours.
paragraphs: Your software is part of how your company grows. We eliminate manual work for your team and give you real control, from inventory to people, so your business keeps growing even when you're away.

That's why the change starts from the inside: your culture, your processes, your people and the way your company shows up to the world. The result is software that drives, accelerates and adapts to your company as if it had always been part of it.

inside.title: From the inside out
inside.description: We learn your operation before we propose anything. The brief is what you tell us; the answer comes from what we see in your company.

process.title: Process over product
process.description: Your workflow is the spec. We don't reshape your team to fit a tool — we shape the tool around your team.

partnership.title: Long-term partnership
partnership.description: We ship, and we stay — evolving your system as your business grows.

services.title: Everything your company needs, built the way it works.

custom.title: Custom systems
custom.description: ERPs, CRMs, internal tools and full applications designed around the exact way your team works.

websites.title: Websites & landing pages
websites.description: Institutional websites, landing pages, online stores and client portals — fast, bilingual-ready, easy for your team to update and built to turn visitors into conversations.

ai.title: AI integration
ai.description: We put AI to work inside your operation — assistants that answer from your own data, automatic reading of documents and emails, smart triage and copilots inside the tools your team already uses. Practical, secure and measured against real results.

automation.title: Automation
automation.description: We map your team's repetitive work — reports, approvals, data entry — and replace it with quiet automations that run while you sleep.

dashboards.title: Dashboards & visibility
dashboards.description: Real-time views of what matters to your business: sales, stock, operations, people. Your decisions stop relying on gut feeling.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Connect the tools your company already uses — accounting, e-commerce, logistics, payments — into one consistent operation.

differentials.title: Built with you, not just for you.
differentials.subtitle: An engineering team that becomes part of your company — your culture, your rituals, your goals — for as long as you need us.

contrast.themEmbedded: Drop a quote, disappear until the demo, send a Slack invite at launch.
contrast.themDiagnostic: Start coding from the first call. Reshape scope mid-sprint.
contrast.themHonest: Hide slippage behind status emojis. Surprise you with a launch delay.
contrast.themLasting: Hand over a black-box codebase nobody on your side can read.

embedded.title: Embedded with your team
embedded.description: We treat your operation like our own. Daily contact, shared rituals, full transparency on what's being built and why.

diagnostic.title: Diagnosis first, code second
diagnostic.description: Every project starts by understanding your business. The scope is written down, priced and signed into the contract. No code until the problem is clear and you've agreed on the plan.

honest.title: Honest delivery
honest.description: Scope, timeline and cost are set in your contract before we start. Daily and weekly updates, working software every sprint. If something slips, you hear it from us first.

lasting.title: Built to last
lasting.description: Clean architecture, documented code and a handover that lets your team keep the system running long after we ship.

process.title: Five phases. You see every step.

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.description: We meet your team, map your pain points, document the problem and define your goal.

modeling.title: Scope
modeling.description: Requirements, architecture, wireframes, timeline and cost, all written into your contract. You know what you'll get, when, and for how much. The materials are handed over once the contract is signed.

execution.title: Execution
execution.description: Agile builds in short cycles. Daily updates and working software every sprint, with code review, tests and clean releases.

control.title: Quality & control
control.description: Continuous testing, scope tracking and a weekly status report. Risks are flagged early, so nothing surprises you at launch.

delivery.title: Delivery & beyond
delivery.description: Final deploy, technical and user documentation, training, and a warranty period. Then ongoing support if you want it.

faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.subtitle: Still have a question? Book a free call and ask us directly.

items.q: How much does a project cost?
items.a: Every project is priced from its scope. Discovery and scope are free: we map your needs and write the scope, timeline and price into a contract proposal before you commit to anything.

items.q: Are discovery and scope really free?
items.a: Yes. We meet your team, document the problem and prepare the scope, timeline and cost at no charge. The materials are handed over once the contract is signed.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: It depends on the scope. Smaller tools take weeks; larger systems are delivered in phases over months. The timeline is written into your contract, and you see working software every sprint.

items.q: How will I know how the project is going?
items.a: You get daily and weekly updates, and you can follow every phase and milestone live in the Adapto Tracker with a private access code.

items.q: What kind of companies do you work with?
items.a: Small and mid-sized businesses whose processes don't fit off-the-shelf software, from retail and services to logistics and operations.

items.q: Do you only work with companies in Vancouver?
items.a: We're based in Vancouver and work with companies across Canada and the United States.
You get documentation, training and a warranty period. After that, we can keep evolving the system with you, or hand it over to your own team.

cookies.body: We use analytics cookies to understand how the site is used. Nothing is loaded until you choose.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body: Adapto Software House is a software studio based in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada. You can reach us at adapto.vancouver@gmail.com for any question about this policy or the data we hold.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: When you submit the contact form we receive your name, email address, company name and the message you write. That is the only personal data we ask for. We use it solely to reply to you and, if it goes further, to run the project we discuss.

sections.heading: Analytics and cookies
sections.body: We use Google Analytics 4 to understand how people find and use this site, and Vercel Speed Insights to measure page performance. Google Analytics sets cookies and only runs after you accept them in the banner. Speed Insights collects anonymous performance timings and sets no cookies. You can change your choice at any time from the link in the footer.

sections.heading: Who we share it with
sections.body: Contact-form messages are delivered through Resend, our email provider. Analytics data is processed by Google. This site is hosted by Vercel. We do not sell your data and we do not share it with anyone else.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
sections.body: Contact-form messages are kept for as long as the conversation stays relevant to a possible or ongoing project, and no more than 24 months after our last exchange. Analytics data follows Google's standard 14-month retention.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can ask us to show you, correct or delete any personal data we hold about you, or withdraw your consent to analytics. Write to adapto.vancouver@gmail.com and we will respond within 30 days. If you are in Quebec, Law 25 gives you these rights.
